questions.explanation: Oddjob is consistently identified as being of Korean nationality, serving as Goldfinger's manservant and enforcer.
questions.question: What nationality is Oddjob specified as being in both the original novel and the film?

meta.lore_desc: A classic henchman from the Bond film 'Goldfinger' who became a legendary and controversial character in GoldenEye 007's multiplayer. His short stature makes him notoriously difficult to hit, leading to a common 'house rule' banning his selection.

questions.explanation: The game's first mission famously opens with James Bond doing a massive bungee jump from the top of the dam to a platform below.
questions.question: The 'Dam' mission begins with James Bond performing what spectacular stunt to infiltrate the facility?

questions.explanation: The mission takes place at the Arkhangelsk Chemical Weapons Facility, located in the northern USSR.
questions.question: What type of facility is Bond infiltrating in this mission?

questions.explanation: One of the first things many players do is climb the initial guard tower to pick up the powerful Sniper Rifle, which is useful for clearing the next area.
questions.question: Early in the level, players can climb a guard tower to find what long-range weapon?

questions.explanation: Regardless of the difficulty, the mission always ends when Bond reaches the designated platform and makes his daring bungee jump escape.
questions.question: What is the final objective on all difficulty levels for this mission?

questions.explanation: On Secret Agent and 00 Agent difficulties, a key objective is to find and neutralize all the alarm panels throughout the level.
questions.question: On higher difficulties, Bond must destroy several of these objects to prevent guards from calling for reinforcements.

questions.explanation: The full name of the location is the Arkhangelsk Chemical Weapons Facility, named after the Russian city of Arkhangelsk.
questions.question: The name of the chemical weapons facility is the same as a real-life port city in the north of Russia. What is it called?

questions.explanation: After neutralizing the alarms in the third area, Bond must shoot a padlock off a chain-link fence to proceed to the final stretch of the level.
questions.question: To open the gates leading to the dam itself, what must Bond shoot off a locked fence?

questions.explanation: One of the added objectives on 00 Agent is to install a covert modem onto a specific computer terminal located behind a building.
questions.question: On the 00 Agent difficulty, Bond has an objective to install what piece of Q-Branch technology?

questions.explanation: There are a total of four alarms that must be destroyed: one in the truck area and one in each of the three guard towers along the dam wall.
questions.question: How many alarms in total must be neutralized on Secret Agent and 00 Agent difficulty?

questions.explanation: Players who can speedrun the Dam on Secret Agent in 2 minutes and 40 seconds or less are rewarded with the fan-favorite Paintball Mode cheat.
questions.question: Completing the Dam mission on Secret Agent difficulty in under 2:40 unlocks what popular cheat mode?

questions.explanation: The hardest objective requires players to navigate the dangerous tunnels beneath the dam to find a server room and intercept a data backup.
questions.question: On 00 Agent, Bond must go into the tunnels beneath the dam to perform what action?

questions.explanation: Players start the first mission equipped with Bond's signature silenced PP7, which is essential for taking out guards quietly.
questions.question: In the film's opening scene, Bond uses a piton gun to attach his bungee cord. In the game, he begins the level with what standard issue sidearm?

questions.explanation: The breathtaking opening stunt was filmed at the Verzasca Dam in Switzerland, which stands in for the fictional Russian facility.
questions.question: The real-world structure used for filming the iconic bungee jump is the Verzasca Dam. In which country is it located?

questions.explanation: If the player accidentally destroys the two large server stacks in the back of the room while fighting guards, the objective will fail.
questions.question: During the 'Intercept data backup' objective, what must the player be careful NOT to destroy in the server room?

questions.explanation: Stuntman Wayne Michaels performed the 220-meter jump, which set a Guinness World Record for the highest bungee jump from a structure in a film.
questions.question: The stuntman who performed the record-breaking bungee jump for the film was named Wayne...?

meta.lore_desc: The iconic opening mission of GoldenEye 007. Set at the Arkhangelsk Chemical Weapons Facility in the USSR, this level introduces players to the game's core mechanics of stealth, combat, and objective-based gameplay, culminating in one of the most famous bungee jumps in cinema history.

questions.explanation: The Facility level famously begins with Bond inside the ventilation system, positioned directly over the stalls of a restroom. [27]
questions.question: In the game's opening level, you start inside an air duct above which type of room?

questions.explanation: Dr. Doak, an MI6 double agent, provides Bond with a Door Decoder needed to access the bottling room. His likeness is based on one of the game's developers, David Doak. [14, 15]
questions.question: On higher difficulties, Bond must contact a double agent scientist to proceed. What is this scientist's name?

questions.explanation: The mission in the Facility is a flashback where Bond meets up with fellow 00-agent Alec Trevelyan. [21]
questions.question: Who does James Bond rendezvous with in the bottling room, nine years before the main events of the game?

questions.explanation: To destroy the chemical weapons, Bond must place Remote Mines on the large tanks in the bottling room. [2]
questions.question: What must Bond plant on the gas tanks in the bottling room to complete his objective?

questions.explanation: A key objective in the Facility is to complete the mission while ensuring the safety of the civilian scientists. [8, 9]
questions.question: What is one of the primary mission objectives on all difficulty levels, related to the non-military personnel?

questions.explanation: On Secret Agent and 00 Agent difficulties, Dr. Doak provides Bond with a special Door Decoder to unlock the path to the bottling room. [14]
questions.question: What item does Dr. Doak give to Bond to help him access the bottling area?

questions.explanation: General Ourumov makes a dramatic entrance, taking 006 captive and setting the stage for Trevelyan's faked death. [21]
questions.question: After Trevelyan is captured, which high-ranking Soviet officer arrives and seemingly executes him?

questions.explanation: To progress, Bond must acquire the 'Clearance B Keycard' from a specific guard in a green uniform located near the bottom of the first stairwell. [27]
questions.question: A guard in a specific colored uniform downstairs from the restroom carries the 'Clearance B Keycard'. What color is his uniform?

questions.explanation: The long corridors of the facility are often protected by ceiling-mounted sentry guns that automatically fire on Bond if he is detected.
questions.question: Besides guards, what automated defense systems are found protecting the hallways leading to the laboratory area?

questions.explanation: The opening mission of the game takes place at a chemical weapons facility in Arkangelsk, a city in the north of European Russia. [6]
questions.question: The mission briefing states this facility is located in which real-world port city of Russia?

questions.explanation: The objective is to destroy the large, stationary bottling tanks in the final room of the facility. [2]
questions.question: On which object does Bond place the remote mines to destroy the chemical agent supply?

questions.explanation: A hidden interaction allows players to follow a fleeing scientist into the restroom, where he will give them the 'Clearance A Keycard' as a reward. [9]
questions.question: If you follow a specific scientist instead of letting him flee, he will retreat to the restroom and give you what item?

questions.explanation: The facility is a production center for a deadly nerve gas, which is why MI6 sends two 00-agents to destroy it. [14]
questions.question: What is the specific name of the chemical agent being produced in the facility?

questions.explanation: Dr. Doak is famously based on David Doak, one of the developers at Rare who worked on the game. [35]
questions.question: Dr. Doak's character model is based on a real-life developer from which company?

questions.explanation: In an earlier version of the game, Dr. Doak was planned to give Bond a Weapon Case, but this was changed to the Door Decoder for the final release. [14]
questions.question: In the game's beta version, what item did Dr. Doak originally give to Bond instead of the Door Decoder?

meta.lore_desc: A remote chemical weapons facility in Arkangelsk, USSR. This is the location of Bond's and Trevelyan's last mission together before 006's apparent death, and the first level of the game.

questions.explanation: The entire Cuban operation, centered on the Cradle, is dedicated to controlling the powerful GoldenEye satellite weapon. [31]
questions.question: The Cradle serves as the control center for which superweapon?

questions.explanation: After tracing the Janus operation, Bond and Natalya discover the GoldenEye control center is hidden in Cuba. [43]
questions.question: The final battle in the game takes place on the massive antenna of the Cradle. In which country is it located?

questions.explanation: Before confronting his old friend, Bond's main objective is to destroy the main control console for the antenna to prevent it from being used. [19, 26]
questions.question: What is the primary objective given by M for the Cradle mission, besides dealing with Trevelyan?

questions.explanation: The climax of the game is the long-awaited final battle between James Bond and the head of Janus, his former friend Alec Trevelyan. [11]
questions.question: Which former 00-agent does Bond have his final showdown with at the Cradle?

questions.explanation: To hide from spy satellites, Trevelyan's base is ingeniously concealed beneath a large, artificial lake that can be drained to reveal the antenna. [7]
questions.question: How is the massive antenna dish of the Cradle concealed from overhead surveillance?
wrong: It's covered by a holographic projection

questions.explanation: Q's concern is that even with the satellite's orbit decaying, Trevelyan could potentially realign the antenna and send one last firing command. [26]
questions.question: In the mission briefing, Q warns that Trevelyan might be able to do what if the control console isn't destroyed?

questions.correct: A small platform at the bottom
questions.explanation: For the final part of the fight, Trevelyan leads Bond to a small, precarious platform at the very bottom of the antenna structure. [19]
questions.question: After defeating enough of his guards, Trevelyan says 'Finish the job, James - if you can!' and retreats to where for the final duel?
wrong: The very top of the spire

questions.explanation: Reflecting the personal nature of the conflict, the game's official objective is to 'Settle the score with Trevelyan'. [11]
questions.question: What is the specific mission objective related to Bond's personal history with the main villain?

questions.explanation: As Bond chases Trevelyan across the walkways, the villain will periodically drop grenades in his path to damage and delay the player. [26]
questions.question: What does Trevelyan often throw behind him to slow Bond's pursuit during the chase across the Cradle's platforms?

questions.explanation: A key mechanic of the fight is that Trevelyan is completely invulnerable to all attacks while he is running from one point to another. [19]
questions.question: While Trevelyan is running between his sniping positions, he is immune to damage. What is the game term for this state?

questions.explanation: Though badly injured from the fall, Trevelyan is finally killed when the entire antenna structure explodes and collapses on top of him. [6]
questions.question: After being defeated, Trevelyan is dropped by Bond and falls to the base of the dish. What ultimately finishes him off?

questions.explanation: In a heroic reversal, Natalya commandeers a helicopter and arrives just in time to rescue Bond from the imminent explosion. [6]
questions.question: Who rescues Bond in a helicopter just moments before the entire Cradle complex is destroyed?

questions.explanation: The iconic setting for the final battle is the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico, which was once the world's largest single-aperture telescope. [42]
questions.question: In the film, the location used for the Cradle is a real-life radio telescope. What is its name?

questions.explanation: After faking his death, Trevelyan established the Janus crime syndicate, a powerful arms dealing organization. [4]
questions.question: What criminal organization does Alec Trevelyan lead from his base at the Cradle?

questions.explanation: Trevelyan's taunt, 'Forgot the first rule of covert operations, did you James? No witnesses!', calls back to their shared past as MI6 agents.
questions.question: During the final confrontation, Trevelyan taunts Bond by asking if he's forgotten the 'first rule of...' what?

meta.lore_desc: The massive antenna cradle of a satellite dish hidden beneath a lake in Cuba. It serves as the control center for the GoldenEye satellite and the stage for the final confrontation between Bond and Alec Trevelyan.

questions.explanation: Severnaya is a top-secret installation situated in the harsh, frozen landscape of Siberia. [12]
questions.question: The Severnaya complex is located in which vast, remote region of Russia?

questions.explanation: Natalya Simonova, a level 2 programmer, is the sole survivor of the initial massacre at the Severnaya control center. [16]
questions.question: Which computer programmer, a key ally to Bond, is a survivor of the attack on Severnaya?

questions.explanation: The most prominent feature of the Severnaya complex is the massive satellite dish used for communicating with the GoldenEye weapon. [32]
questions.question: What type of large structure dominates the landscape of the Severnaya Surface levels?

questions.explanation: Bond's objective is to use a Key Analyzer to make a copy of the GoldenEye activation key while leaving the original behind to avoid suspicion. [28]
questions.question: In the first Bunker mission, what must Bond do to the GoldenEye key?

questions.explanation: Bond finds the 'invincible' hacker Boris Grishenko working at the mainframe inside the Severnaya bunker. [3]
questions.question: Who is the arrogant computer programmer working for Janus that Bond encounters in the Severnaya bunker?

questions.explanation: In the mission 'Surface 2', one of Bond's primary objectives is to disable the communications link by destroying the satellite dish's control console. [37]
questions.question: During the second visit to Severnaya, what must Bond do to the main satellite dish?

questions.explanation: On 00 Agent difficulty, Bond must attach the Data Thief gadget to the mainframe to acquire the necessary intelligence. [28]
questions.question: In the first Bunker level, what piece of Q-Branch gadgetry must Bond use to download data from the mainframe?

questions.explanation: General Ourumov and Xenia Onatopp arrive at Severnaya in a stolen, EMP-hardened Tiger helicopter to take control of the GoldenEye. [16]
questions.question: What type of enemy vehicle does Janus use to attack the Severnaya facility at the start of the incident?

questions.explanation: After entering his password, Boris inadvertently triggers the base's security alarm, forcing Bond to fight his way out. [3]
questions.question: In the first Bunker mission, what does Boris accidentally do after Bond forces him to access the mainframe?

questions.explanation: Janus detonates one of the two GoldenEye satellites in the atmosphere above Severnaya, creating an EMP to destroy all electronics and hide the evidence of their theft. [7]
questions.question: To cover their tracks, Janus uses one of the GoldenEye satellites to generate what kind of blast over Severnaya?

questions.explanation: A key objective in the second bunker mission is to retrieve the Severnaya staff list, which helps MI6 identify who is working for Janus. [37]
questions.question: In the mission 'Bunker 2', what crucial document must Bond recover that lists the names of Janus operatives?

questions.explanation: In a moment of levity, the password Boris is forced to type to access the system is 'KNOCKERS'. [3]
questions.question: What is the password Boris Grishenko uses to log in to the mainframe in the Bunker?

questions.explanation: While her colleagues are being gunned down in the control room, Natalya survives because she had stepped into the small kitchen for coffee just moments before the attack. [22]
questions.question: What does Natalya hide in to survive the initial onslaught by Xenia Onatopp and General Ourumov?

questions.explanation: After escaping in a small plane, Bond crashes and must retrieve the flight recorder from the wreckage as part of his objectives in the second Surface mission.
questions.question: In 'Surface 2', Bond must retrieve the flight recorder from which downed aircraft?

questions.explanation: The in-game coordinates for Severnaya place it in the general vicinity of the Tunguska event, a massive, unexplained explosion that flattened over 2,000 square kilometers of Siberian forest. [12]
questions.question: The coordinates for Severnaya given in the mission briefing (62.08N, 102.58E) place it near the site of what mysterious, real-life explosion from 1908?

meta.lore_desc: A remote satellite control and research facility located deep in Siberia. Believed by the world to be an abandoned observatory, it secretly houses the command center for the GoldenEye weapon system.

questions.explanation: The GoldenEye system is comprised of two satellites, named Petya and Mischa. [1]
questions.question: The GoldenEye weapon system consists of how many operational satellites?

questions.explanation: The GoldenEye's primary function is to create a powerful electromagnetic pulse, or EMP, to destroy electronic circuits over a wide area. [1]
questions.question: What kind of devastating pulse does the GoldenEye satellite generate?

questions.explanation: The Janus crime syndicate, led by Alec Trevelyan, is responsible for stealing the controls to the GoldenEye weapon. [4]
questions.question: Which criminal syndicate hijacks the GoldenEye satellite?

questions.explanation: To erase evidence of the theft of the GoldenEye control disk, Janus uses the satellite 'Petya' to hit the Severnaya facility itself. [7]
questions.question: Where does Janus use the first GoldenEye satellite to cover their tracks?

questions.explanation: Trevelyan's master plan is to cause a global financial meltdown by using the GoldenEye to wipe out all of London's financial records. [6]
questions.question: What is Alec Trevelyan's ultimate target for the second GoldenEye satellite blast?

questions.explanation: Using her exceptional programming skills, Natalya hacks into the GoldenEye system from the Janus control center in Cuba to avert the disaster. [43]
questions.question: What device does Natalya Simonova use to reprogram the GoldenEye satellite?

questions.explanation: Each satellite carries a nuclear warhead, which is detonated high in the atmosphere to create the electromagnetic pulse. [7]
questions.question: The GoldenEye satellites, Petya and Mischa, are armed with what kind of device to generate the EMP?

questions.explanation: Natalya cleverly reprograms the satellite to de-orbit, causing it to burn up harmlessly during atmospheric re-entry. [6, 7]
questions.question: What does Natalya reprogram the satellite to do in order to destroy it?

questions.explanation: The core of Trevelyan's plan is to electronically transfer billions from the Bank of England and then use the GoldenEye to erase any record of the theft. [6]
questions.question: Trevelyan's plan involves stealing money electronically from which major financial institution just before the EMP blast?

questions.explanation: In the Silo level, Bond's objective is to photograph an incomplete satellite which has distinctive blue solar panels. [40]
questions.question: In the mission 'Silo', Bond must take a photograph of a satellite. What color are its folded solar panels?

questions.explanation: The first satellite, designated 'Petya', is sacrificed to wipe out the Severnaya complex and cover up the theft of the control system. [7]
questions.question: What is the name of the first GoldenEye satellite, which is used to destroy the Severnaya facility?

questions.explanation: With 'Petya' destroyed, Trevelyan's plan hinges on the use of the second satellite, 'Mischa', to attack London. [7]
questions.question: What is the name of the second, remaining GoldenEye satellite that Trevelyan intends to use on London?

questions.explanation: The firing system has a fail-safe requiring two separate keys to be turned in perfect synchronization to activate the targeting system. [1]
questions.question: In order to activate the GoldenEye system, two conventional keys must be turned with what specific requirement?

questions.explanation: The Eurocopter Tiger is stolen specifically because it has been hardened against electromagnetic pulses, allowing Janus to operate it within the blast radius of GoldenEye. [31]
questions.question: A prototype helicopter is stolen by Janus because it has what special defensive capability, making it useful during a GoldenEye attack?

questions.explanation: The idea of the GoldenEye satellite was inspired by Project Excalibur, a real-world Cold War concept for an X-ray laser system as part of the 'Star Wars' defense program. [10]
questions.question: The real-world concept for a space-based nuclear weapon that inspired GoldenEye was part of which U.S. strategic defense initiative?

meta.lore_desc: A top-secret Soviet orbital weapons system. The GoldenEye consists of satellites armed with a nuclear device designed to detonate in the upper atmosphere, generating a devastating electromagnetic pulse (EMP) to disable all electronics in a target area.

questions.explanation: The Silenced PP7 is Bond's starting weapon in many missions, including the iconic Dam level, allowing for quiet takedowns.
questions.question: In many missions, Bond begins with a version of the PP7 that has a key attachment for stealth operations. What is this attachment?

questions.explanation: Q, the head of Q-Branch, is responsible for providing James Bond with all his gadgets and weapons, including his trusty PP7.
questions.question: The PP7 is the signature weapon of MI6 agents. Who is the head of the department responsible for creating and issuing these gadgets?

questions.explanation: The PP7 holds 7 rounds in its magazine, requiring agents to be precise with their shots.
questions.question: What is the standard magazine capacity for a single PP7?

questions.explanation: The gun barrel sequence, a staple of the Bond franchise, features the silhouette of Bond firing his PP7.
questions.question: The iconic opening sequence of the game features Bond firing a pistol at the screen. What is this signature weapon?

questions.explanation: The in-game PP7 is a direct homage to the Walther PPK, James Bond's signature weapon in the novels and films.
questions.question: The PP7 is based on a real-world German pistol that is famously associated with James Bond. What is its name?

questions.explanation: If you collect two safe keys in the Bunker 2 level, you can unlock a safe containing dual Silenced PP7s.
questions.question: In the 'Bunker 2' mission, where can a special pair of Silenced PP7s be found, allowing Bond to dual-wield them?

questions.explanation: The Russian Commandant in the first Bunker mission is one of the only NPCs in the entire game to use the PP7.
questions.question: While most guards carry automatic rifles, a specific high-ranking Russian officer in 'Bunker 1' uses a standard PP7. What is his title?

questions.explanation: True to his character, the clumsy hacker Boris fumbles his PP7 immediately after drawing it in the Control Center.
questions.question: In the mission 'Control,' Boris Grishenko pulls a PP7 on Natalya. What happens immediately after he draws the weapon?

questions.explanation: The weapon's full name is the 'PP7 Special Issue', signifying it's a piece of equipment specifically for 00-agents.
questions.question: What is the full, official designation of this weapon in the Q-Branch inventory?

questions.explanation: The Gold PP7 cheat gives the pistol the one-shot-kill power of the Golden Gun but with a full 7-round magazine.
questions.question: If you complete the 'Cradle' level on the 00 Agent difficulty within the target time, you unlock a cheat for a powerful version of this pistol. What is it called?

questions.explanation: The Silver PP7 is a cheat weapon that functions like a normal PP7 but with the high damage output of the powerful Cougar Magnum.
questions.question: A cheat code unlocks a slightly more powerful variant of this pistol that shares the damage properties of the Cougar Magnum. What is this version called?

questions.explanation: Using a loud weapon like the standard PP7 in the Dam will cause the guards to trigger the alarm, making the mission much more difficult.
questions.question: In the first 'Dam' mission, firing the unsilenced version of the PP7 near guards will cause them to do what?

questions.explanation: The Watch Magnet Attract, primarily used in Bunker 2, can also be used to pull the PP7 and its ammo clip off a table in the Archives.
questions.question: In the 'Archives' mission, Bond can find a PP7 and its ammunition on a table. What nearby gadget can be used to retrieve the weapon from a distance?

questions.explanation: Despite being silenced, firing the PP7 too quickly will still make enough noise to attract the attention of close-by enemies.
questions.question: While the silenced PP7 is quieter than the standard model, what action can still alert nearby guards to your presence?

questions.explanation: Bond's infiltration of the Arkangelsk facility, which includes the Dam, Facility, and Runway levels, starts him with the silenced PP7.
questions.question: In which chemical warfare facility does Bond begin his mission equipped with the silenced PP7?

meta.lore_desc: The quintessential firearm for a 00-agent, the PP7 is James Bond's reliable, easily concealed starting pistol. Based on the real-world Walther PPK, it's the trusted tool for missions requiring discretion and precision.

questions.explanation: The Golden Gun is legendary for being a one-shot-kill weapon, capable of defeating any enemy instantly.
questions.question: What is the most famous and deadly feature of the Golden Gun?

questions.explanation: The Golden Gun is the signature weapon of Francisco Scaramanga, the world's most expensive assassin.
questions.question: Which villain, known as 'The Man with the Golden Gun,' is the original owner of this weapon?

questions.correct: The Man with the Golden Gun
questions.explanation: In 'The Man with the Golden Gun' multiplayer mode, players fight to control the single Golden Gun that spawns on the map.
questions.question: A specific multiplayer scenario is centered entirely around this weapon. What is the name of this mode?

questions.explanation: Living up to its high-risk, high-reward nature, the Golden Gun holds only a single bullet and must be reloaded after every shot.
questions.question: How many bullets can the Golden Gun hold in its magazine at one time?

questions.explanation: When playing 'The Man with the Golden Gun', the weapon always spawns with a single box of ammunition for it.
questions.question: In multiplayer, what item typically spawns in the same location as the Golden Gun?

questions.explanation: The Golden Gun is found as a special weapon in the bonus level 'Egyptian', accessible after beating the main story.
questions.question: In which bonus mission must Bond navigate a booby-trapped temple to acquire the Golden Gun?

questions.correct: A shield covers the gun and turrets appear
questions.explanation: Stepping on an incorrect tile in the puzzle room causes a bulletproof shield to protect the gun and activates four deadly drone guns.
questions.question: To get the gun in the Egyptian level, Bond must walk across a specific sequence of floor tiles. What happens if he steps on the wrong tile?
wrong: Poison darts shoot from the walls

questions.explanation: Due to his extremely high health, especially on higher difficulties, the Golden Gun is the recommended weapon for defeating Baron Samedi.
questions.question: Which voodoo-themed adversary in the 'Egyptian' level is most effectively dispatched with the Golden Gun?

questions.explanation: Interestingly, the powerful Golden Gun uses the same firing sound effect as the D5K Deutsche submachine gun.
questions.question: The Golden Gun shares its distinct firing sound with which silenced submachine gun?

questions.explanation: The Golden Gun is famously constructed from a fountain pen (the barrel), a cigarette lighter (the firing mechanism), and a cigarette case (the handle).
questions.question: What common, everyday items does Scaramanga use to assemble the Golden Gun?
wrong: Tie clip, ring, and shoe heel

questions.explanation: In multiplayer with custom health modifiers set extremely high, Jaws is one of the few characters who can withstand a shot from the Golden Gun.
questions.question: While the Golden Gun can kill almost any character in one shot, which massive, metal-toothed henchman can sometimes survive a hit in multiplayer if health settings are high enough?

questions.explanation: With the 'All Guns' cheat active, it's possible for Bond to equip two Golden Guns simultaneously for double the deadly, single-shot action.
questions.question: Though only one Golden Gun exists, using the 'All Guns' cheat allows Bond to do what with the weapon?
wrong: Use it as a melee weapon

questions.explanation: Perfect Dark, also developed by Rare, features the gold-plated DY357-LX pistol, which is a direct tribute to the Golden Gun and also kills in one shot.
questions.question: What is the name of the homage weapon in the spiritual successor game, Perfect Dark, that functions identically to the Golden Gun?

questions.correct: Their score is transferred to the new wielder
questions.explanation: A unique rule in this mode is that any kills earned with the Golden Gun are transferred to the next player who picks it up, making the weapon itself the scoring object.
questions.question: In the multiplayer mode 'The Man with the Golden Gun,' what happens to the kill-score of a player who is eliminated while holding the gun?
wrong: Their score is reset to zero

questions.explanation: A rare exception to the one-shot-kill rule is that if the bullet strikes only the enemy's weapon, they will survive the encounter.
questions.question: A shot from the Golden Gun will instantly kill an enemy if it hits their body. What happens if the shot only hits the gun they are holding?

meta.lore_desc: The legendary signature weapon of the assassin Francisco Scaramanga. Assembled from a pen, lighter, and cigarette case, this unique pistol is famed for its single, deadly bullet, capable of eliminating any target with one shot.

questions.explanation: Proximity Mines, as their name suggests, detonate when any moving character enters their detection range.
questions.question: What triggers the explosion of a Proximity Mine?

questions.explanation: A common and effective multiplayer strategy is to place Proximity Mines near Body Armor spawns to catch players trying to gain a health advantage.
questions.question: In multiplayer, these mines are notoriously used to booby-trap what valuable pickups?

questions.explanation: Once thrown, the Proximity Mine arms itself and begins to flash with a distinct red light, warning observant players of the danger.
questions.question: What color does the light on the Proximity Mine blink once it is armed?

questions.explanation: Proximity Mines are adhesive, allowing players to place them on any surface, including walls, ceilings, and around corners, for creative traps.
questions.question: What happens when you throw a Proximity Mine onto a wall or ceiling?

questions.explanation: The game features three types of mines: Proximity, Timed (which explode after a set duration), and Remote (which are manually detonated).
questions.question: Besides Proximity Mines, what other type of throwable mine can be detonated by a timer?

questions.correct: Gas tanks in the bottling room
questions.explanation: In the Facility, one of the main objectives is to use Remote Mines to destroy the large gas tanks in the bottling room where Bond meets Alec Trevelyan.
questions.question: In the 'Facility' mission, Bond must use mines to complete an objective. What must he destroy?

questions.correct: Place the mine on the crate and pick up the ammo
questions.explanation: A well-known glitch allows players to make a mine invisible by placing it on an ammo box and then quickly picking up the ammunition before the mine arms.
questions.question: In multiplayer, what sneaky trick can be used with a Proximity Mine and an ammo crate to make the mine invisible?
wrong: Shoot the mine with a silenced weapon
Place two mines on top of each other

questions.explanation: The mines are sensitive to velocity, meaning a player can sneak past one without triggering it by walking very slowly or moving while aiming.
questions.question: How can a player safely get past an enemy's Proximity Mine without setting it off?
wrong: By throwing a grenade at it

questions.explanation: The only mission in the single-player campaign where Proximity Mines are available as a standard weapon is in the military Depot.
questions.question: In which single-player mission are Proximity Mines found as a weapon pickup?

questions.explanation: As a player gets close to a Proximity Mine, it will begin to beep rapidly, giving them a brief moment to react before it detonates.
questions.question: What distinct sound does a Proximity Mine make to alert a player that they are about to trigger it?

questions.explanation: Players often toss mines into the air vents in the Facility, as an unlucky opponent can spawn inside and be immediately eliminated.
questions.question: In the 'Facility' multiplayer map, a common strategy is to throw Proximity Mines into the vents above which specific room?

questions.explanation: Due to his short stature, Oddjob can sometimes walk right under Proximity Mines that would have been triggered by any other character.
questions.question: Which famously short character in multiplayer is notoriously difficult to hit with Proximity Mines placed at standard chest height?

questions.correct: Yes, explosions can damage players through thin surfaces
questions.explanation: Explosions in the game can deal splash damage through thin walls and doors, making them effective for attacking enemies who are taking cover.
questions.question: If you throw a mine on the outside of a thin wall or door, can the explosion harm a player on the other side?
wrong: No, explosions are blocked by all surfaces
Only if the door is made of wood
Only if the mine is a Remote Mine

questions.explanation: The Motion-Sensor Bomb item in Super Smash Bros. Melee was modeled after and functions identically to the Proximity Mine from GoldenEye 007.
questions.question: In the Super Smash Bros. series, an item directly inspired by the Proximity Mine appears under what different name?

questions.explanation: After a Proximity Mine is thrown, there is a short 'arming time' before it becomes active, which allows the player who threw it to get clear of the blast radius.
questions.question: There is a brief delay after throwing a Proximity Mine before it becomes active. What is this period called?

meta.lore_desc: A favorite tool for ambush and area denial in multiplayer matches. This throwable explosive sticks to any surface and detonates when an unsuspecting opponent moves within its trigger radius.

questions.correct: A metal panel in the floor
questions.explanation: While trapped on Alec Trevelyan's armored train, Bond uses his Watch Laser to cut a hole in a floor panel, allowing him and Natalya to escape.
questions.question: In the mission 'Train,' Bond must use the Watch Laser to escape from a dire situation. What does he cut open?
wrong: The locks on the main door

questions.explanation: The Watch Laser is one of the many ingenious gadgets supplied to Bond by Q, the head of Q-Branch.
questions.question: Which MI6 quartermaster is responsible for inventing and issuing this high-tech timepiece?

questions.explanation: When Bond has Remote Mines equipped, selecting the watch in the menu transforms it into a detonator to trigger the explosives.
questions.question: Besides emitting a laser, the watch serves another critical function in Bond's inventory. What is it used for?

questions.explanation: The film marked the first time James Bond wore an Omega Seamaster, which has since become the character's signature watch brand.
questions.question: What real-world luxury brand is Bond's watch in the film 'GoldenEye,' on which the game is based?

questions.explanation: The iconic pause screen shows Bond's watch, which displays his current health and body armor levels as red and green bars.
questions.question: The watch's pause screen interface displays two vital statistics for Bond on its face. What are they?

questions.explanation: To escape a locked room in the Silo, Bond uses the Watch Laser to destroy the padlock on a floor hatch.
questions.question: In the mission 'Silo,' Bond uses the laser to escape from a locked room. What object does he cut the lock off of?

questions.correct: A blue bar at the bottom
questions.explanation: When the laser is active, a blue bar labeled 'LASER' appears at the bottom of the watch face, depleting as it's used.
questions.question: The laser has a finite amount of power before it needs to recharge. How is the remaining charge displayed on the watch?
wrong: A number next to the date

questions.explanation: In the movie, Q explicitly demonstrates that the watch contains both the cutting laser and a remote detonator for bombs.
questions.question: In the film, Q mentions that the laser is not the only feature of the watch. What other device is built into it for setting off explosives?

questions.explanation: The top of the watch face in the pause menu reads 'G WATCH V2.01 BETA', giving it the feel of prototype Q-Branch technology.
questions.question: What is the version number of the 'G. WATCH' software displayed at the top of the watch face on the pause screen?

questions.explanation: Along with the health and armor bars, the watch face displays the text 'MISSION STATUS INCOMPLETE' until all objectives are met.
questions.question: What text is displayed at the bottom of the watch face, indicating that Bond's work is not yet done?

questions.explanation: In the prologue of the film, set nine years before the main story, laser technology was much bulkier, requiring Bond to use a large laser mounted on a pistol.
questions.question: In the first level of the game, the Dam, the laser is unavailable. What similar, but much larger, Q-gadget does Bond use to cut a lock on a gate?

questions.correct: To pull metallic objects towards Bond
questions.explanation: The Watch Magnet Attract is a different Q-gadget used to retrieve items like keys and weapons that are just out of reach.
questions.question: Another gadget, the 'Watch Magnet Attract,' is used in the Bunker levels. What is its primary function?

questions.explanation: A pro-level trick for using remote mines is to press the A and B buttons simultaneously, which detonates them instantly without having to switch to the watch.
questions.question: A button combination allows for quick detonation of remote mines without switching to the watch interface. On the N64 controller, what is this combination?

questions.explanation: The exact model Pierce Brosnan wore in GoldenEye was an Omega Seamaster Professional Diver 300M, which housed the fictional laser gadget.
questions.question: What is the specific model of the Omega watch used in the film?

questions.explanation: Though it was cut from the final game, code exists for a 'Watch Magnet Repel' gadget, which would have performed the opposite function of the 'Attract' version.
questions.question: An unused gadget called the 'Watch Magnet Repel' exists in the game's code. What was its intended function?

meta.lore_desc: A sophisticated Q-Branch gadget disguised as an elegant timepiece. This watch conceals a powerful laser capable of cutting through steel, perfect for escaping traps or creating new paths where none exist.

questions.explanation: Ghast Tears are a key ingredient for brewing Potions of Regeneration, which are incredibly useful for surviving the harsh Nether environment.
questions.question: What valuable brewing ingredient, used to make Potions of Regeneration, can be obtained by defeating me?

questions.explanation: Ghasts are native to the Nether and can be found ominously floating through its vast, cavernous spaces.
questions.question: In which fiery, dangerous dimension am I exclusively found floating around?

questions.explanation: Ghasts attack from a distance by launching explosive fireballs, which can destroy weaker blocks and set the terrain on fire.
questions.question: What projectile do I shoot from my mouth when I spot a player?

questions.explanation: When defeated, Ghasts can drop Gunpowder, which is a key ingredient for crafting TNT and Fire Charges.
questions.question: Besides my tears, what common crafting component used for explosives do I sometimes drop upon defeat?

questions.explanation: A well-timed swing with a sword, or even a projectile like an arrow, can deflect a Ghast's fireball back at it, dealing massive damage.
questions.question: Players can knock my primary projectile back at me. What is the most common tool used to do this?

questions.explanation: A calm Ghast will float around with its eyes closed, but they will snap open once it acquires a target.
questions.question: When I am passively floating and have not detected a player, what state are my eyes usually in?

questions.explanation: Having adapted to their fiery home, Ghasts are completely immune to damage from fire and lava.
questions.question: I am immune to one specific type of damage because I live in the Nether. What is it?

questions.explanation: Ghasts can spawn in most open areas of the Nether, including Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valleys, and Basalt Deltas, but they avoid the dense fungal forests.
questions.question: In which of these Nether biomes would you be LEAST likely to find me?

questions.explanation: The iconic and often unsettling sounds of the Ghast were created by manipulating a recording of the sound designer's cat when it was disturbed.
questions.question: My eerie, high-pitched sounds were created by the game's sound designer using a recording of what real-world animal?

questions.explanation: If a player uses a sword enchanted with Looting to deflect a fireball and defeat a Ghast, the enchantment will increase the amount of gunpowder and Ghast Tears dropped.
questions.question: Deflecting one of my fireballs back to defeat me with a sword that has a specific enchantment will apply that enchantment's effects to my drops. What is that enchantment?

questions.explanation: To craft an End Crystal, which is used to respawn the Ender Dragon, a player needs to combine a Ghast Tear, an Eye of Ender, and Glass.
questions.question: A Ghast Tear can be combined with an Eye of Ender and what other material to craft an End Crystal?

questions.explanation: Before the Ender Dragon was added to the game, the massive, 4x4 block Ghast was the largest mob in all of Minecraft.
questions.question: Until the introduction of the Ender Dragon, I held the title of being what in the game?
wrong: The mob with the most health

questions.explanation: The planned 'Happy Ghast' is a new, friendly variant that players can ride. It's spawned from a Ghastling, which in turn comes from a waterlogged Dried Ghast block.
questions.question: According to an upcoming update, a new friendly, rideable version of me can be obtained by hydrating a 'Dried Ghast' block. What is this new variant called?

questions.explanation: The crafting recipe for the new Dried Ghast item, found near Nether Fossils, involves surrounding one block of Soul Sand with eight Ghast Tears.
questions.question: The crafting recipe for a 'Dried Ghast' block requires a block of Soul Sand and how many Ghast Tears?

questions.explanation: A Ghast requires a significant amount of open space to spawn, needing a clear area of at least 5 blocks wide, 4 blocks high, and 5 blocks long.
questions.question: What is the minimum amount of open space required for me to be able to spawn in the Nether?

meta.lore_desc: These large, ghost-like, flying mobs inhabit the Nether. They are known for their distinctive, sorrowful cries and their ability to shoot explosive fireballs at players who wander into their territory.

questions.explanation: Despite their intimidating appearance, Iron Golems have a soft side and will occasionally offer a poppy to a villager.
questions.question: What flower do I sometimes hold in my hand and offer to Villagers as a sign of my gentle nature?

questions.explanation: To build an Iron Golem, a player must arrange four Blocks of Iron in a 'T' shape.
questions.question: Players can construct me themselves. What type of block is used to form my 'T-shaped' body?

questions.explanation: The final step to creating an Iron Golem is placing a Carved Pumpkin or a Jack o'Lantern on top of the center iron block.
questions.question: What item must be placed on top of my iron body, as the final step, to bring me to life?

questions.explanation: Iron Golems naturally spawn in villages and will patrol the area, protecting the Villagers from any hostile threats.
questions.question: What group of passive mobs am I programmed to protect, often found wandering around their homes?

questions.explanation: When an Iron Golem is defeated, it drops Iron Ingots, which can be used to craft a variety of tools and armor.
questions.question: Besides Poppies, what is the primary material I drop when defeated?

questions.explanation: A player can heal a damaged Iron Golem by using an Iron Ingot on it, which will gradually repair the visible cracks on its body.
questions.question: If a player-built version of me is damaged, what item can be used on me to repair the cracks in my body?

questions.explanation: Iron Golems can be found imprisoned in dark oak cages at Pillager Outposts. If freed, they will help the player fight the pillagers.
questions.question: Besides villages, in what hostile structures can I sometimes be found trapped inside a cage?

questions.explanation: Since one Block of Iron requires nine Iron Ingots to craft, a total of 36 ingots are needed to create the body of an Iron Golem.
questions.question: How many iron ingots are required to craft the four blocks of iron needed to build me?

questions.explanation: Naturally spawned Iron Golems will turn on a player if they see them harming a Villager, as their primary directive is to protect them.
questions.question: A golem that a player creates will never attack its creator. However, a naturally spawned golem will become hostile if you attack what?

questions.explanation: For reasons unknown, Iron Golems are completely passive towards Creepers and will not attack them under any circumstances.
questions.question: There is one common, explosive hostile mob that I will not attack, even if it gets close to a Villager. Which one is it?

questions.explanation: A Jack o'Lantern can be used in place of a Carved Pumpkin to create an Iron Golem, and it functions identically.
questions.question: If you build me with this alternate head, I will still spawn, but I will also provide a source of light. What is this block?

questions.explanation: Spawning an Iron Golem for the first time will grant the player the 'Hired Help' achievement.
questions.question: Which in-game achievement is typically awarded to a player for creating an Iron Golem for the first time?

questions.explanation: Players have designed 'Iron Farms' which create artificial villages to spawn Iron Golems, who are then automatically defeated to collect a large amount of Iron Ingots.
questions.question: What automated farm are players likely to build that relies on my spawning mechanics within a village to gather a specific resource?

questions.explanation: An Iron Golem cannot be created if a piston is used to place the pumpkin; the player must place the final block by hand.
questions.question: What block placement tool is explicitly prevented from placing the final pumpkin head to create me?

questions.correct: I might spawn inside the wall and suffocate
questions.explanation: Building an Iron Golem too close to a wall can cause it to spawn partially inside the blocks, leading to it taking suffocation damage and potentially dying.
questions.question: If you build my T-shaped body directly against a wall, what is a potential negative outcome?
wrong: I will spawn with less health
I will be hostile to the player

meta.lore_desc: A large, strong, construct mob created from iron. Iron Golems are powerful guardians, often found patrolling villages to protect the inhabitants from hostile mobs. They can also be built by players.

questions.explanation: To tame a wolf, a player must feed it bones. It may take several attempts, but eventually, hearts will appear, and it will become a loyal pet.
questions.question: What item do you need to feed me to have a chance at taming me and making me your loyal companion?

questions.explanation: A successfully tamed wolf will have a red collar appear around its neck, which can then be changed to different colors using dye.
questions.question: Once I am tamed, what appears around my neck to signify my loyalty to you?

questions.explanation: The eyes of a wild or tamed wolf will glow a menacing red when it becomes aggressive.
questions.question: If I am attacked, what color do my eyes change to as I become hostile?

questions.explanation: Players can right-click on a tamed wolf to make it sit, and it will remain in that spot until told to stand up again.
questions.question: What action can a player make me do so I stay in one spot and don't follow them?

questions.explanation: A tamed wolf that is not sitting will teleport to its owner if they move too far away, ensuring they are never left behind.
questions.question: If you get too far away from me, what magical ability do I have to catch up to you instantly?

questions.explanation: Wolves are natural enemies of Skeletons and will attack them without any command from the player.
questions.question: What common, undead ranged enemy will I attack on sight, even without being provoked?

questions.correct: Become hostile and attack the player
questions.explanation: Wolves are pack animals; attacking one member of a pack will cause all nearby wolves to become hostile towards the attacker.
questions.question: If a player attacks an untamed wolf that is part of a group, what will the rest of the group do?
wrong: Turn on the wolf that was attacked

questions.explanation: The higher a tamed wolf's tail is, the more health it has. As it takes damage, its tail will lower.
questions.question: A tamed wolf's health can be determined by observing the angle of what part of its body?

questions.explanation: Tamed wolves with full health can be bred by feeding them any kind of raw or cooked meat, including rotten flesh.
questions.question: To breed two tamed wolves, what type of item must you feed them?

questions.explanation: A player can use any color of dye on their tamed wolf to change the color of its collar.
questions.question: My default collar color is red, but what item can be used on me to change it to any other color?

questions.explanation: Wild wolves will naturally hunt sheep, rabbits, foxes, and baby turtles.
questions.question: Besides Skeletons, which small, passive mob am I known to hunt in the wild?

questions.explanation: Wolves most commonly spawn in Forest and Taiga biomes, often in packs of four.
questions.question: Which of these biomes is the most common place to find me spawning in packs?

questions.explanation: Perhaps sensing the danger, tamed wolves will not attack Creepers, even if their owner attacks one first.
questions.question: A tamed wolf will assist its owner in attacking most mobs, but which explosive enemy will it refuse to engage?

questions.explanation: The classic, most recognizable variant of the wolf is known as the Woods Wolf and is found in the Forest biome.
questions.question: What is the specific name for the most common wolf variant, found in the Forest biome?

questions.explanation: Just like a real-world dog, a wolf in Minecraft will shake its body to fling off water droplets after being submerged.
questions.question: After getting out of water, what animation will I perform to dry myself off?

meta.lore_desc: A neutral mob that roams the forests and taigas of the Overworld. Wolves can be tamed by players to become loyal companions, assisting them in battle and following them on their adventures.

questions.explanation: Using an empty bucket on a cow will yield a Bucket of Milk, which can be used to craft cake or clear all status effects from the player.
questions.question: If you use an empty bucket on me, what useful liquid will you receive?

questions.explanation: Cows are attracted to players holding wheat, which can be used to lead them into pens and breed them.
questions.question: What food item, when held by a player, will cause me to follow them?

questions.explanation: Cows are a primary source of leather, a crucial component for crafting item frames, books, and a full set of leather armor.
questions.question: What crafting material, essential for making books and armor, do I drop when defeated?

questions.explanation: When a cow's raw beef is cooked in a furnace, smoker, or on a campfire, it becomes a steak, which is a very effective food source.
questions.question: What is the name of the food item you get by cooking the raw meat that I drop?

questions.explanation: The Mooshroom is a rare cow variant found exclusively in the Mushroom Fields biome, recognizable by the red mushrooms growing on its back.
questions.question: What is the name of my rare, red-colored variant that is covered in mushrooms?

questions.explanation: Drinking a bucket of milk is incredibly useful as it instantly clears the player of all active status effects, both positive and negative.
questions.question: Drinking a bucket of my milk has a special property. What does it do to the player?

questions.explanation: While a bucket on a Mooshroom gives milk, using a bowl will fill it with Mushroom Stew, providing a renewable food source.
questions.question: If you use a bowl on my mushroom-covered cousin, what food item do you receive?

questions.explanation: Mooshrooms are unique to the Mushroom Fields biome, which are often isolated islands covered in mycelium and giant mushrooms.
questions.question: In what specific, rare biome does my 'Mooshroom' variant exclusively spawn?

questions.explanation: A red Mooshroom will turn into a brown Mooshroom if it is struck by lightning, and vice-versa.
questions.question: If my red Mooshroom variant is struck by a certain natural phenomenon, it will transform into a brown Mooshroom. What is it?

questions.explanation: Like most mobs, when a cow is defeated by a player or a tamed wolf, it drops experience orbs.
questions.question: Besides leather and beef, what else do I drop when defeated by a player?

questions.explanation: Feeding a specific flower to a brown Mooshroom and then 'milking' it with a bowl will produce Suspicious Stew, granting a status effect corresponding to that flower.
questions.question: If you feed a flower to a brown Mooshroom and then use a bowl on it, what special type of stew do you get?

questions.explanation: Shearing a Mooshroom turns it into a normal cow and causes it to drop five mushrooms of its corresponding color.
questions.question: Using shears on a Mooshroom will transform it into a regular cow and cause it to drop what item?

questions.explanation: A baby cow, or calf, takes one full in-game day (20 minutes of real-world time) to grow into an adult.
questions.question: How long does it take for a baby cow to mature into an adult?

questions.explanation: Each time a baby cow is fed wheat, its remaining growth time is reduced by 10%.
questions.question: Feeding me wheat when I am a calf will speed up my growth. By how much does each feeding reduce the remaining time?

questions.explanation: Mooshrooms only spawn naturally on Mycelium blocks, which cover the surface of Mushroom Field biomes.
questions.question: What is the name of the block that Mooshrooms exclusively spawn on in their native biome?

meta.lore_desc: A common passive mob found in grassy biomes across the Overworld. Cows are a valuable resource for players, providing meat, leather, and milk, and are often one of the first animals domesticated.

questions.explanation: When defeated, adult sheep drop 1-2 pieces of Raw Mutton, which can be cooked and eaten.
questions.question: Besides wool, what food item does an adult sheep drop when defeated?

questions.explanation: Using Shears on a sheep will cause it to drop 1-3 blocks of wool and leave it temporarily sheared, after which it will regrow its wool by eating grass.
questions.question: What tool is used to gather wool from a sheep without harming it?

questions.explanation: Sheep are attracted to players holding Wheat, and feeding it to two adult sheep will cause them to enter 'love mode' and breed.
questions.question: What item can be held by a player to make sheep follow them?

questions.explanation: A sheared sheep will regrow its wool by eating a grass block, which turns it into a dirt block in the process.
questions.question: What must a sheared sheep do to regrow its wool?

questions.explanation: Players can use any of the 16 colors of dye directly on a sheep to permanently change the color of the wool it produces.
questions.question: What item is used to change the color of a sheep's wool directly on the animal?

questions.explanation: While most sheep spawn as white, they can also naturally be black, gray, light gray, brown, and, very rarely, pink.
questions.question: Which of these is the RAREST natural wool color for a sheep to spawn with?

questions.explanation: When breeding two sheep of different colors, the baby lamb has an equal chance of inheriting the color of either one of its parents.
questions.question: If you breed a blue sheep and a yellow sheep, what color will the baby sheep be?
wrong: A mix of Blue and Yellow

questions.explanation: Like other animals that drop meat, if a sheep is defeated while burning, it will drop its cooked variant, Cooked Mutton, instead of raw.
questions.question: If a sheep is defeated while on fire, what will its meat drop as?

questions.explanation: When a sheep is invisible, its body vanishes but its wool remains fully visible, floating in the air until it is sheared.
questions.question: Applying an Invisibility Potion to a sheep has what strange visual effect?

questions.explanation: Defeating a lamb yields no items or experience orbs, encouraging players to wait for them to mature.
questions.question: What happens if a lamb is defeated?
wrong: It drops a small amount of XP

questions.correct: Its wool cycles through all colors
questions.explanation: As an Easter egg, naming a sheep 'jeb_' will cause its wool to continuously fade through the entire color spectrum. However, shearing it will only yield its original wool color.
questions.question: If a sheep is named 'jeb_' with a name tag, what special effect does it gain?

questions.correct: The sheep regrows wool but the grass remains
questions.explanation: With the 'mobGriefing' gamerule turned off, sheep can still eat grass to regrow their wool, but the grass block itself is no longer converted to dirt.
questions.question: What happens to the grass block when the gamerule 'mobGriefing' is set to 'false' and a sheep eats it?
wrong: The sheep cannot eat the grass
The grass turns to coarse dirt

questions.explanation: The Looting enchantment increases the maximum amount of mutton an adult sheep can drop from 2 up to 5 with Looting III.
questions.question: Which enchantment on a sword increases the maximum amount of mutton a sheep can drop?

questions.explanation: If a wild or tamed wolf defeats a sheep, it will not drop any items or experience. The player must land the final blow to get the drops.
questions.question: If a wolf attacks and defeats a sheep, what will the sheep drop?

questions.explanation: In a very early development version of Minecraft Classic, sheep would drop mushrooms upon being defeated.
questions.question: In early versions of the game, before wool, what peculiar item did sheep drop when defeated?

meta.lore_desc: One of the first passive mobs added to the game, these woolly creatures roam the Overworld, eating grass and providing players with a renewable source of wool and mutton. They can be dyed in a variety of colors, making them a walking rainbow of resources.

questions.explanation: Spiders drop 0-2 pieces of String when defeated, a crucial component for crafting items like Bows, Fishing Rods, and Scaffolding.
questions.question: What is the primary material dropped by spiders, used for crafting bows and fishing rods?

questions.explanation: Spiders are able to climb up any solid vertical surface, making them a threat that can easily overcome player-built walls.
questions.question: What unique ability do spiders possess that allows them to traverse terrain easily?

questions.explanation: Spiders are hostile in darkness but become neutral when the light level is high enough, such as during the daytime.
questions.question: Under what condition does a spider become neutral and not attack the player on sight?
wrong: If the player is holding a torch
If the player is wearing a pumpkin

questions.explanation: Cave Spiders are a more dangerous variant of the regular spider, distinguished by their blue color and ability to inflict poison.
questions.question: What is the name of the smaller, blueish variant of the spider found in abandoned mineshafts?

questions.explanation: When killed by a player, a spider has a 1 in 3 chance of dropping a Spider Eye, which is a key ingredient for brewing Potions of Poison.
questions.question: What item, used in potion brewing, has a chance of dropping from a spider when defeated by a player?

questions.explanation: A Spider Jockey is a rare occurrence where a Skeleton spawns riding a Spider, combining the spider's mobility with the skeleton's ranged attack.
questions.question: What is the rare mob combination called when a skeleton is found riding on the back of a spider?

questions.explanation: Unlike regular spiders, Cave Spiders will inflict the Poison status effect on the player, draining their health over time.
questions.question: The Cave Spider is infamous for inflicting what status effect with its bite?

questions.explanation: Spiders, Cave Spiders, Silverfish, and Endermites are all classified as Arthropods, meaning the Bane of Arthropods sword enchantment deals extra damage to them.
questions.question: Spiders are classified as what type of mob, making them vulnerable to the Bane of Arthropods enchantment?

questions.explanation: Monster Spawners found in dungeons have a chance to be spider spawners, and woodland mansions can also contain secret rooms with them.
questions.question: Besides spawning in the dark, where can spiders commonly be found generating from a specific block?

questions.explanation: If a spider has been provoked during the day, taking damage from an environmental source like a cactus or a fall will reset its aggression, making it neutral again.
questions.question: What happens to a spider's hostility if it takes damage from a source like falling, while it's in daylight?
wrong: It calls other spiders for help

questions.explanation: Even when a player is completely obscured by solid blocks, a hostile spider can still detect them and will move towards their position.
questions.question: True or False: A spider can still see and track a player through solid blocks.

questions.explanation: In the Nether, there is a small chance for a Spider Jockey to spawn with a Wither Skeleton as the rider instead of a normal one.
questions.question: If a spider spawns in the Nether, what type of skeleton has a chance to be riding it?

questions.correct: The spider becomes hostile towards the skeleton
questions.explanation: If the skeleton component of a Spider Jockey damages its own mount, the spider will retaliate, and the two will begin fighting each other.
questions.question: What strange interaction occurs if a skeleton rider accidentally shoots its own spider mount?

questions.explanation: A spider's AI checks the light level of the block it is currently on. If that level is 11 or less, it will remain hostile, even if it's daytime.
questions.question: Spiders will not attack players during the day unless the light level immediately around the spider is below what number?

questions.explanation: A Spider Eye is the base ingredient for brewing a Potion of Poison, which can then be corrupted into other potions like Harming or Slowness.
questions.question: Which of these status effects can be applied to a player using a Spider Eye in a brewing stand?

meta.lore_desc: A common hostile mob known for its glowing red eyes in the dark. These eight-legged creatures can climb walls and leap at their targets. Uniquely, they become neutral in daylight unless provoked, making them a conditional threat.

questions.explanation: The Wither is the only source of the Nether Star, a rare item required to craft a Beacon.
questions.question: What valuable item, used to craft a Beacon, is dropped when the Wither is defeated?

questions.explanation: The Wither is a floating, skeletal boss with three heads, each capable of firing projectiles independently.
questions.question: How many heads does the Wither have?

questions.explanation: The Wither's attacks apply the dangerous 'Wither' effect, which drains health over time and can defeat the player, unlike Poison.
questions.question: What status effect does the Wither's projectile skulls inflict on players?

questions.explanation: To summon the Wither, players must place four blocks of Soul Sand or Soul Soil in a 'T' shape.
questions.question: What block, found in the Nether, is used to form the body of the Wither's summoning structure?

questions.explanation: The final step to summoning the Wither is to place three Wither Skeleton Skulls on top of the Soul Sand frame.
questions.question: What item must be placed on top of the summoning structure to create the Wither?

questions.explanation: Once its health bar is full, the Wither creates a powerful explosion that destroys nearby blocks and can heavily damage the player.
questions.question: What happens immediately after the Wither's health bar finishes charging upon being summoned?

questions.explanation: Wither Skeleton Skulls are a rare drop from Wither Skeletons, which are found exclusively in Nether Fortresses.
questions.question: The skulls required to summon the Wither are a rare drop from which Nether-dwelling mob?

questions.explanation: The Wither will not attack other undead mobs like Zombies, Skeletons, and its own kind unless provoked.
questions.question: The Wither is hostile to all mobs except for which category?

questions.explanation: At half health, the Wither gains an armor effect that makes it completely immune to damage from arrows, forcing a switch to melee combat.
questions.question: When the Wither's health drops below half, it gains a protective armor. What effect does this armor have?

questions.explanation: A Wither Rose, a unique flower that inflicts the Wither effect on mobs that touch it, is generated on the block where a mob dies to the Wither.
questions.question: What special flower is created whenever the Wither kills another mob?

questions.explanation: In the Bedrock Edition of the game, the Wither will perform a special move at 50% health, breaking blocks around it and summoning 3-4 Wither Skeletons to aid it in battle.
questions.question: In Bedrock Edition, what does the Wither do when it reaches half health, besides gaining arrow immunity?

questions.explanation: The Wither shares the undead mob trait of having inverted potion effects, meaning it is healed by damage potions and harmed by healing potions.
questions.question: Like other undead mobs, the Wither is damaged by Splash Potions of Healing and healed by Splash Potions of what?

questions.explanation: The damage and block-breaking power of the Wither's spawn-in explosion is scaled based on the world's difficulty, being weakest on Easy and strongest on Hard.
questions.question: The Wither's initial summoning explosion has a different power level based on what game setting?

meta.lore_desc: A terrifying, three-headed undead boss mob that players must construct themselves to fight. It floats, fires explosive skulls, and inflicts a life-draining 'Wither' effect. Defeating it is the only way to obtain a Nether Star.

questions.explanation: A bow is crafted using three Sticks and three pieces of String on a crafting table.
questions.question: What two materials are required to craft a Bow?

questions.explanation: Bows require Arrows to function, which can be crafted, found, or obtained as drops from Skeletons.
questions.question: What is the standard ammunition used by a Bow?

questions.explanation: Skeletons are common undead mobs that are equipped with a bow and will shoot arrows at the player on sight.
questions.question: Which hostile mob is known for using a Bow to attack players from a distance?

questions.explanation: The Flame enchantment imbues arrows with fire, causing them to deal extra fire damage over time to any mob they hit.
questions.question: What enchantment causes arrows shot from a bow to set enemies on fire?

questions.explanation: The Infinity enchantment allows a bow to be fired as long as the player has at least one arrow in their inventory, without using it up.
questions.question: What enchantment allows a bow to fire arrows without consuming them from the player's inventory?

questions.explanation: Similar to Sharpness for swords, the Power enchantment increases the base damage of arrows shot from the bow, with a maximum level of V.
questions.question: What enchantment increases the direct damage dealt by arrows from a bow?

questions.explanation: The Punch enchantment adds a knockback effect to arrows, which is useful for keeping enemies at a distance.
questions.question: What enchantment increases the knockback of arrows, pushing enemies further away?

questions.explanation: An Anvil allows you to combine an enchanted bow with another bow to repair its durability while preserving the enchantments, at the cost of experience levels.
questions.question: Which block can be used to repair an enchanted bow without losing its enchantments?

questions.explanation: Tipped Arrows are a special type of ammunition that can be crafted to apply a specific potion effect to any mob or player they hit.
questions.question: Arrows that apply potion effects are known by what name?

questions.explanation: Multishot is an enchantment unique to the Crossbow that fires a spread of three arrows while only consuming one from the inventory.
questions.question: What is the crossbow-exclusive enchantment that allows firing three arrows at once?

questions.explanation: The Mending enchantment will channel any collected experience orbs to repair the durability of the bow if it is damaged, making it last indefinitely with enough XP.
questions.question: What enchantment uses experience orbs to automatically repair the bow's durability?

questions.explanation: While Infinity allows for unlimited standard arrows, it does not work on Tipped Arrows or Spectral Arrows, which will always be consumed when fired.
questions.question: The Infinity enchantment does not work on which type of special arrow?

questions.explanation: A player must choose between having infinite arrows with Infinity or having the bow repair itself with Mending, as the two enchantments cannot be applied to the same bow in survival mode.
questions.question: Which two enchantments are mutually exclusive, meaning they cannot be on the same bow?

questions.explanation: Spectral Arrows, crafted with Glowstone Dust, apply the Glowing status effect to their target, which highlights the entity's outline even through solid blocks.
questions.question: What type of arrow creates a glowing outline around a target, making them visible through walls?

questions.explanation: A standard bow has 384 durability points, meaning it can be used 384 times before it breaks.
questions.question: What is the maximum durability of a standard, unenchanted bow?

meta.lore_desc: The quintessential ranged weapon in Minecraft. Crafted from sticks and string, it allows players to attack enemies from a safe distance using arrows. It can be enhanced with a variety of powerful enchantments to increase its damage, add special effects, or improve its durability.

questions.explanation: Golden Apples grant both Regeneration and Absorption, providing a quick heal and a buffer of extra hearts.
questions.question: Besides restoring hunger, eating a Golden Apple grants you temporary extra hearts. What is this status effect called?

questions.explanation: The recipe for a Golden Apple requires one apple in the center, surrounded by eight Gold Ingots.
questions.question: To craft a standard Golden Apple, you need to surround a regular apple with what material on a crafting table?

questions.explanation: After splashing a Zombie Villager with a Potion of Weakness, using a Golden Apple on them will begin the curing process.
questions.question: This powerful food item is one of the only ways to reverse the zombification of a certain mob. Which mob can be cured with a Golden Apple after being weakened?

questions.explanation: Golden Apples are a highly effective food for breeding horses and will improve the chances of taming a wild one by 10%.
questions.question: Besides players, which of these animals can be fed a Golden Apple to increase the chances of taming them and to speed up their growth as babies?

questions.explanation: When consumed, a Golden Apple grants Regeneration II for five seconds, which is a very fast rate of healing.
questions.question: Along with Absorption, what other primary status effect do you receive upon eating a Golden Apple, which gradually restores your health over time?

questions.explanation: The Enchanted Golden Apple, sometimes called a 'Notch Apple' or 'God Apple' by the community, is a much more potent variant that cannot be crafted.
questions.question: The much rarer and more powerful version of this item, which grants superior effects like Fire Resistance, has what name?

questions.explanation: While Golden Apples can be found in many structures, the basement of an Igloo will always contain the necessary items to cure a Zombie Villager, including a Golden Apple.
questions.question: You can sometimes find Golden Apples as loot inside chests. In which of these structures is a Golden Apple a guaranteed find?

questions.explanation: Piglins are irresistibly drawn to gold items, and will pick up and inspect a Golden Apple if they see one.
questions.question: Which hostile Nether mob is known to be attracted to Golden Apples, stopping to admire one if it's dropped on the ground?

questions.explanation: The now-removed recipe for the Enchanted Golden Apple required an apple surrounded by eight solid Blocks of Gold, equivalent to 72 Gold Ingots.
questions.question: The original crafting recipe for the Enchanted Golden Apple was removed from the game. Instead of Gold Ingots, what did this expensive recipe require?

questions.explanation: The 'Thing' banner pattern, which resembles the old Mojang logo, is crafted using an Enchanted Golden Apple and a piece of paper.
questions.question: The Enchanted Golden Apple can be used to craft a unique Banner Pattern. What is the name of this pattern?

questions.explanation: Eating an Enchanted Golden Apple grants Absorption IV, which provides eight extra hearts for two minutes.
questions.question: The Enchanted Golden Apple provides a much stronger version of the Absorption effect than its regular counterpart. What level of Absorption does it grant?

questions.explanation: Ancient Cities offer the best chance of finding an Enchanted Golden Apple, with a notable 8.4% chance per chest.
questions.question: In which of these generated structures would you have the highest probability of finding an Enchanted Golden Apple in a chest?

questions.explanation: In addition to Regeneration and Absorption, the Enchanted Golden Apple grants both Resistance and Fire Resistance for five minutes, making the player incredibly durable.
questions.question: Eating an Enchanted Golden Apple grants five minutes of two powerful defensive status effects. One is Resistance; what is the other?

questions.explanation: Based on the real-world density of gold, the 8 blocks of gold required for the old recipe would weigh a staggering 154,560 kilograms.
questions.question: Before they became uncraftable, Enchanted Golden Apples were considered one of the heaviest items in the game based on the real-world weight of gold. One apple surrounded by 8 blocks of gold would weigh over how many kilograms?

meta.lore_desc: A rare, magical fruit that grants powerful regenerative effects to those who consume it. It is highly sought after by adventurers for its ability to turn the tide in a desperate battle and even cure zombification.

questions.explanation: A full cake provides seven individual slices, with each slice restoring a small amount of hunger.
questions.question: Unlike other foods, the Cake must be placed as a block in the world before it can be eaten. How many slices can you get from a single, whole cake?

questions.explanation: The recipe calls for three units of Wheat across the bottom row of the crafting grid to form the base of the cake.
questions.question: To craft a cake, you need three buckets of Milk, two piles of Sugar, an Egg, and what other ingredient?

questions.explanation: Chickens will periodically lay eggs on the ground, which can be collected by the player and used in recipes like the cake.
questions.question: What common farm animal is the source of the eggs required to bake a cake?

questions.explanation: Once a cake is placed, it cannot be picked back up. Breaking the block will simply destroy it without dropping anything.
